style="background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,45,32,.72),rgba(20,45,32,.18)),url('/images/stay/valampuri-stay-lagoon-sunset-hero-q40.webp')" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><div data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><p class="crumb" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Home / Stay</p><h1 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Rooms at Valampuri by the Lagoon</h1><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Steps from the lagoon. Mornings are quiet. The wind starts when it starts. Pick the room that fits your trip: everything else is already at Valampuri.</p><div class="hero-trust-line" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg> Local Family-Owned Since 2016</span><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg> Direct Lagoon Access</span><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg> 10,000 m² Lagoon-Side Property</span><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg> Up to 42 Guests</span><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg> Eco-Built, Locally Sourced</span></div></div></section><section class="quick-answer-wrap"><div class="quick-answer"><p class="quick-answer__label"><svg></svg> Quick Answer</p><p class="quick-answer__text"><strong>Valampuri Resort offers 8 room types from €18 per person per night on Kalpitiya Lagoon, Sri Lanka.</strong> Options range from the Wind Rider Dorm for budget solo travellers to the Garden Family Suite sleeping up to 6. All rooms are set within a 10,000 m² lagoon-side property with a swimming pool, seafood restaurant, and direct access to Kalpitiya Lagoon. Breakfast is included with every room. The resort is also an <a href='/kitesurfing-lessons/'>IKO-certified kite school</a>: guests can add <a href='/rates-offers/#kite-packages'>kitesurfing packages</a> with lessons, equipment, and boat transfers.</p><div class="quick-answer__cta"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="https://wa.me/94776314144?text=Hi%20Valampuri%2C%20I%27d%20like%20to%20ask%20about%20room%20availability%20and%20rates.%20Dates%3A%20__" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ask About Rooms</a></div></div></section><section class="feature-grid section-light stay-trust-grid" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><h2 class="sr-only" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>What you get at Valampuri</h2><article data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg></span><h3 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Meal Options for Every Stay</h3><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Breakfast and dinner at the lagoon-side restaurant come with selected rooms; every room can upgrade to half or full board.</p></article><article data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg></span><h3 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Pool on the Property</h3><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>A resort pool set in the garden, steps from the chalets and the lagoon waterfront.</p></article><article data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg></span><h3 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Free Wi-Fi</h3><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Wi-Fi reaches most of the property, including the restaurant, pool, garden and rooms.</p></article><article data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg></span><h3 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Premium Duotone Equipment</h3><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Quality Duotone kites and boards available for riders adding lessons or rental.</p></article><article data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg></span><h3 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Free Boat Transfer</h3><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Free seated boat transfer to the kite spot: the boat leaves right from our lagoon front.</p></article><article data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><span data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><svg></svg></span><h3 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>10 Min Boat Ride to Kite Beach</h3><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>The main Kalpitiya kite launch is a 10-minute boat ride from the resort: the boat leaves right from our lagoon front.</p></article></section><section class="section compact-section" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><p class="eyebrow" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Location</p><h2 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Where should I stay for kitesurfing in Kalpitiya?</h2><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Choose accommodation with direct lagoon access, an on-site kite school, and equipment storage. Valampuri Resort sits directly on Kalpitiya Lagoon with its own IKO kite school, gear storage (€5/day), a boat launch point, and eight room types starting at €18 per person.</p></section><section class="section" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><div class="two-col" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><div data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><p class="eyebrow" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Room guide</p><h2 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>How do you choose the right room for your stay?</h2><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>The main choice is usually between budget, privacy, and space. Dorm guests tend to want the lowest-cost setup close to the kite center, couples often prefer a double or chalet, and families usually need larger rooms with more beds and easier pool-and-garden access.</p><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>If you're planning the full trip with lessons, rental, or a package, the prices and bundles are on <a class="text-link" href="/rates-offers/" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Rates &amp; Offers</a>. This page helps you pick the right room first.</p><div class="button-row" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/rates-offers/" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>See Rates &amp; Offers</a><a class="btn btn-outline" href="/kitesurfing-lessons/" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>View Kite Lessons</a></div></div><div class="info-card" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><h3 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>What matters most</h3><ul class="list-check" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><li data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>How much privacy you want</li><li data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Whether you need AC, extra beds, or more space</li><li data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>How close you want to be to pool and shared areas</li><li data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Travelling solo, as a couple, or with family</li><li data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>How the room fits your total trip budget</li></ul></div></div></section><section class="section compact-section" style="padding-top:20px;padding-bottom:20px" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><p class="center" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Planning both the room and the riding? Start with <a class="text-link" href="/kitesurfing-lessons/" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>beginner kitesurfing lessons in Kalpitiya</a>, compare <a class="text-link" href="/rates-offers/#kite-packages" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>kitesurfing packages</a>, check lagoon-side accommodation, see <a class="text-link" href="/kite-rentals/" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>kite rentals</a>, and review the <a class="text-link" href="/kitesurfing-season-sri-lanka/" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Kalpitiya kite season guide</a>.</p></section><section class="section section-soft" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><div class="section-heading" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><p class="eyebrow" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Choose your room</p><h2 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Accommodation options</h2><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Private chalets, terrace doubles, family stays, and a dorm option for kite travellers.</p><!-- Anchoring: show booking.com/competitor context before our prices --><div style="display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:10px 0;align-items:center;background:rgba(20,45,32,.05);border:1px solid rgba(20,45,32,.12);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 16px" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><span style="font-size:14px;color:var(--mid)" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Kalpitiya rooms via booking platforms:</span><span style="font-size:14px;text-decoration:line-through;color:#aaa" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>€55–€120/night</span><span style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#213A2B" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Direct with us: from €18 p/p · no fees</span></div><!-- Social proof before room choice --><blockquote style="font-size:14px;font-style:italic;margin:10px 0;padding:8px 14px;border-left:3px solid #dab164;background:rgba(218,177,100,.06);border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;text-align:left" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>"Clean rooms, amazing location, very easy to book. data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><h2 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Room price note</h2><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Prices shown are indicative. Final availability and seasonal rates should be confirmed before booking. Prices marked * may vary by season.</p></div><a class="btn btn-light" href="/contact/" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Check My Dates</a></div></section><section class="section" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><div class="wide-cta" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><div data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><h2 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Not sure which room fits your trip?</h2><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Tell us your dates, number of guests, and whether you need lessons, rental, or just a room. We'll suggest the right option and send the best available rate, fast reply by WhatsApp.</p></div><a class="btn btn-light" href="/contact/" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Plan My Holiday</a></div></section><section class="section faq-section" id="stay-faq" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><div class="section-heading" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><p class="eyebrow" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Stay FAQ</p><h2 data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Questions about kitesurfing accommodation in Kalpitiya</h2></div><div class="faq-list" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><details class="faq-item" open data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Should I stay on the lagoon or near the beach?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Lagoon-side accommodation is more convenient for kitesurfing. Most lessons and flat-water riding happen on the lagoon, not the open sea. Valampuri is lagoon-side, with boat transfers to ocean-side spots like Vella Island and Dream Spot included in longer courses and trip packages.</p></details><details class="faq-item" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>What private rooms do you have?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Valampuri has seven private room types: Poolside Comfort Chalet (19 sqm, AC, from €35 pp), Open-Air Cabana (15 sqm, AC, from €30 pp), Garden Eco Chalet (15 sqm, from €20 pp), Comfort Terrace Double (17 sqm, from €25 pp), Family Eco Chalet (23 sqm, from €25 pp), Garden Family Suite (34 sqm, €90 for up to 6), and Essential Double (17 sqm, from €18 pp).</p></details><details class="faq-item" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Do the rooms have air conditioning?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>You can have either. Valampuri offers both AC and non-AC rooms: Poolside Comfort Chalet and Open-Air Cabana come with AC, and AC can be added to most other room types for a small supplement. Tell us your preference when you book.</p></details><details class="faq-item" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Do you take monthly or long-term bookings?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Yes, and we discount them. Rates depend on the room, the season, how many of you there are and whether you want meals, so we quote each one. Message us with your dates and how long you want to stay and we will send you a price.</p></details><details class="faq-item" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>What does an extra night cost?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>€40 per additional night on half board (breakfast and dinner), which works out to €20 per person for two people sharing.</p></details><details class="faq-item" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Are family rooms available?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Yes. The Family Eco Chalet (23 sqm, queen + double bed, from €25 pp, AC available +€7) sleeps families of 3–4. The Garden Family Suite (34 sqm, two singles + two doubles, €90 for up to 6 guests) is the largest room and suits bigger families or friend groups.</p></details><details class="faq-item" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Can non-kiters enjoy the resort?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Yes. Non-kiters can use the pool, eat at the seafood restaurant, kayak the lagoon (€10 pp), join a dolphin watching trip, take a lagoon mangrove tour (from $30 pp), visit Wilpattu National Park for a safari, or explore the 10,000 sqm garden.</p></details><details class="faq-item" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Are kite holidays suitable for couples?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Yes. One partner can kite while the other enjoys the pool, kayaking (€10 pp), lagoon tours (from $30 pp), or dolphin watching. The Learn Together Escape (€245 pp, 2 sharing) lets couples learn together, and the Open-Air Cabana (€30 pp double, "Best for Couples") offers a private terrace with hammock and lagoon views.</p></details><details class="faq-item" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Can I work remotely from Valampuri?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Yes. Free Wi-Fi reaches most of the property, rooms included, and the garden and common areas are quiet enough to work in. The Nomad Extended Stay package is 10 nights in an eco chalet with half board and high-speed internet from €250 per person. Some guests kite in the morning and work in the afternoon.</p></details><details class="faq-item" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Is Valampuri suitable for families?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Yes. Families can stay in the Family Eco Chalet (23 sqm, queen + double bed, private terrace, from €25 pp) or the Garden Family Suite (34 sqm, sleeps up to 6, €90 total). The pool, garden, kayaking, and nature activities keep children and non-kiting family members entertained.</p></details><details class="faq-item" data-astro-cid-cmu42rob><summary data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Where should I stay for kitesurfing in Kalpitiya?</summary><p data-astro-cid-cmu42rob>Choose accommodation with direct lagoon access, an on-site kite school, and equipment storage. Valampuri Resort sits directly on Kalpitiya Lagoon with its own IKO kite school, gear storage, boat launch point, and eight room types starting at €18 per person.</p></details></div></section><script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","name":"Rooms at Valampuri","url":"https://www.valampuriresort.com/stay/","description":"Compare room options at Valampuri, including chalets, doubles, family rooms, and dorm accommodation by the lagoon in Kalpitiya.","about":["Rooms at Valampuri","Lagoon stay in Kalpitiya","Valampuri room options"],"isPartOf":{"@id":"https://www.valampuriresort.com/#resort"}}</script><script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"ItemList","name":"Valampuri Accommodation Options","itemListElement":[{"@type":"ListItem","position":1,"name":"Poolside Comfort Chalet"},{"@type":"ListItem","position":2,"name":"Open-Air Cabana"},{"@type":"ListItem","position":3,"name":"Garden Eco Chalet"},{"@type":"ListItem","position":4,"name":"Comfort Terrace Double"},{"@type":"ListItem","position":5,"name":"Family Eco Chalet"},{"@type":"ListItem","position":6,"name":"Garden Family Suite"},{"@type":"ListItem","position":7,"name":"Essential Double"},{"@type":"ListItem","position":8,"name":"Wind Rider Dorm"}]}</script><script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Where should I stay for kitesurfing in Kalpitiya?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Choose accommodation with direct lagoon access, an on-site kite school, and equipment storage.
